about_the_game:
Peganomics is a roguelike pachinko where strategy meets chaos. Drop balls, hit pegs, and fill buckets to rack up massive scores while chasing the perfect run. Build wild synergies between your balls, pegs, and buckets then watch your combos spiral out of control as you bend the board to your will.

Every run is different: experiment with game-breaking builds, discover unpredictable interactions, and push your score higher and higher. Will you master the economy of pegs, or go bust chasing the ultimate combo?
